root: Uni-CLI 1.0.2 adds a complete OpenReview venue archive for public submissions, reviews, rebuttals, decisions, revisions, PDFs, supplementary files, and external research links.
OpenReview access now uses browser-derived sessions, bounded token refresh, strict request pacing, rate-limit-aware retries, durable cursors, transactional files, and SHA-256 verification.
Venue groups and edit history drive conference discovery and lifecycle reconstruction across current API v2 and older API v1 records.
The patch also preserves AT-SPI accessible names, makes visual evidence claims atomically single-use, and hardens durable MCP task persistence on Windows.
zh: Uni-CLI 1.0.2 新增完整的 OpenReview venue 归档，覆盖公开投稿、审稿、rebuttal、决定、revision、PDF、补充材料和外部研究链接。
OpenReview 访问现在使用浏览器登录态、有界 token refresh、严格请求节奏、感知 rate limit 的重试、持久 cursor、事务文件和 SHA-256 校验。
Venue group 与 edit history 驱动会议发现和生命周期重建，同时覆盖当前 API v2 与旧 API v1 记录。
本次 patch 还保留 AT-SPI accessible name，使 visual evidence claim 具备原子单次消费，并强化 Windows 上的 MCP task 持久化。
